children: NORFOLK, Va., Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- PRA Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: PRAA), a global leader in acquiring and collecting nonperforming loan portfolios, will report its third quarter 2026 results after market close on Thursday, November 5, 2026, followed by a webcast and conference call at 5 p.m. E.T.
To listen to PRA Group's webcast and view the corresponding slides, visit

. To listen by phone on November 5, call 646-357-8785 in the U.S. or 1-800-836-8184 outside the U.S. and ask for the PRA Group conference call. To listen to a replay of the call, either visit the same website until November 5, 2027, or call 646-517-4150 in the U.S. or 1-888-660-6345 outside the U.S. and use access code 65294# until November 12, 2026.

As a global industry leader with more than 30 years of experience, PRA Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: PRAA) specializes in acquiring and collecting nonperforming loans. PRA Group purchases portfolios from banks and other creditors and, through its subsidiaries, collaborates with customers to help them resolve their debt. Headquartered in Norfolk, Virginia, PRA Group has operations in the U.S., Europe, and other markets. For more information, please visit
